method: Independently viewed the full-resolution image object on page 1 of each held one-page PDF. The images were rendered temporarily outside the repository and deleted after review. Read the page visually against, but did not copy from, its embedded OCR layer.
scope: Separate attributed source-only transcription proposals; no source-grade, identity, claim, lifecycle or independent-review approval

items.visual_findings: Header, full March 4 excusal, complete departmental/public-reasons and existing-law proviso, Woodrow Wilson signature block, White House date 12 February 1921 and printed No. 3403 are legible.
uncertainties: An isolated handwritten marginal annotation below the printed number is illegible; marked in brackets in the transcription. It does not appear in the operative text.

items.visual_findings: Header; complete half-mast sentence including District of Columbia/Washington March 5 and Missouri/Bowling Green March 7, respectively; Woodrow Wilson signature block; White House date 3 March 1921; upper-right handwritten 3415 are legible.
uncertainties: Final glyph of the printed [No. 3415] line is worn; shown as [5?] inside the printed-number bracket. The upper-right handwritten 3415 is clear but does not silently repair the printed glyph.
The upper-right 'Temporary' appears as a printed or stamped mark; its production method is uncertain and the transcription labels it as such.
